exposure: GDM diagnosis (GDM group vs healthy control group)
outcome: Myometrial elasticity (measured using shear wave elastography)
cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth at Affiliated Hospital of Yangzhou University between August 2022 and July 2023.
finding: Myometrial elasticity, measured at the placental attachment site, was higher in women with GDM compared to healthy pregnant women, and was positively correlated with obstetric complications.
